ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of PDQDeployRunner
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious execution of "PDQDeployRunner" which is part of the PDQDeploy service stack that is responsible for executing commands and packages on a remote machines

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\PDQDeployRunner\\-.*") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\csc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-encodedcommand\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*iex\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*"))))
